{{Current events header|2015|02|27}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
* American actor [[Leonard Nimoy]], best known for his role as [[Spock]] from the ''[[Star Trek]]'' franchise, dies at the age of 83 from complications of [[COPD]]. [http://www.msn.com/en-us/tv/news/leonard-nimoy-%E2%80%98star-trek%E2%80%99s%E2%80%99-spock-dies-at-83/ar-BBi2SNv?ocid=fbmsn (MSN.com)]

;Law and crime
*[[Avijit Roy]], an American writer and blogger from Bangladesh, is hacked to death by unknown attackers in [[Dhaka]]. [http://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/worldnews/asia/bangladesh/11438812/Atheist-US-blogger-hacked-to-death-in-Bangladesh.html (''The Telegraph'')]
*A gunman kills seven people then himself in a [[2015 Tyrone shooting|series of shootings]] in [[Tyrone, Missouri|Tyrone]], [[Missouri]]. [http://www.nbcnews.com/news/crime-courts/nine-dead-including-gunman-after-missouri-shooting-spree-police-n314071 (''NBC News'')]
*In Moscow, an unidentified attacker [[Murder of Boris Nemtsov|assassinates]] leading Russian opposition politician [[Boris Nemtsov]], the former [[Deputy Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation]] and current member of [[Regional parliaments of Russia|regional parliament]] of [[Yaroslavl Oblast]]. [http://www.euronews.com/2015/02/27/russian-opposition-politician-boris-nemtsov-shot-dead-in-moscow/ (euronews)] [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-31669061 (BBC)]
*An elderly man [[2015 Hwaseong shooting|shoots and kills]] three people and then himself in the [[South Korea]]n city of [[Hwaseong, Gyeonggi|Hwaseong]]. [http://english.yonhapnews.co.kr/national/2015/02/27/64/0302000000AEN20150227002851315F.html (Yonhap News)] [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20150227000323 (''The Korea Herald'')] [http://www.latimes.com/world/asia/la-fg-south-korea-shooting-20150226-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
*Mexican security forces arrest drug lord [[Servando Gómez Martínez]] in [[Morelia, Michoacán]]. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/01a936bc4aed4932a334c38ae79c7935/mexico-official-top-capo-nabbed-western-michoacan-state (AP)]
